name: After § 5
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the recent hybrid attacks and instrumentalisation of migrants in Ceuta and the need for a coordinated response to protect the EU’s external borders
part_text: 5a. Expresses its strong solidarity with Spain, as it has done for other Member States targeted by hybrid attacks; reiterates the need for all Member States to effectively protect the EU’s external borders, in compliance with relevant international law, in particular the Geneva Convention;
